# A molehill: a low mound of loose earth around a dark hole 0.6 m across. Up Z.
new
add mesh cone --name Mound --vertices 10 --radius1 0.62 --radius2 0.42 --depth 0.14 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 0.07
material new Mound --base-color 0.467 0.361 0.310
material assign Mound
add mesh cylinder --name Hole --vertices 10 --radius 0.42 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.04
material new Hole --base-color 0.090 0.055 0.098
material assign Hole
active Hole
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export hole.glb
